source.title: Regulatory Technical Standards on ICT risk management framework and on simplified ICT risk management framework
source.applicability: Harmonises ICT risk management requirements across financial sectors; identifies elements for standard and simplified frameworks under Articles 6 and 16 of DORA

passages.text: The Regulatory Technical Standards on ICT risk management framework identify further elements related to ICT risk management with a view to harmonise tools, methods, processes and policies.

These elements are complementary to those identified in DORA. The RTS identify the key elements that financial entities subject to the simplified regime and of lower scale, risk, size and complexity would need to have in place, setting out a simplified ICT risk management framework.
